page.layout: Running head at top, page number at top left. Two round woodcut medallions side by side at the top, each with a printed legend. Below them one column of running text, with two entries, the second starting after a paragraph break. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: ARCHELAVS magni Herodis Ascalonitæ filius, succesit patri in regno Iudæorum anno mundi 3964. post Christum natum 2. Augustus imperator Archelaum Idumææ, Iu-dææ,& Samariæ: Antipam, qui & Herodes, Galilææ: Philippum Gaulanitidis, Trachonitidis, Bathaniæ, & Paneados Tetrarchas ex testamento Herodis designauit. Hic Archelaus in ip-sis regni auspiciis modestus admodum, noluit Rex appellari, donec confirmaretur ab Imperatore, apud quem ab Antipatro fratre accusatus, absoluitur. Confirmatus Tetrarcha, male administrauit. Accusatus iterum apud Imperatorem, exilio damnatur, & relegatur in Galilæam: postea Cyrenius ac post eum Pilatus Romanorum nomine Iudæam administrant. Iose. lib. Antiq. 17. cap. 10. vsque ad finem 17. & lib. 2. de bel. Iudæa.cap. 4. Regnauit Archelaus annis nouem, & desiit regnum Iudæorum: nam [?]Iudæa in prouinciam redacta, Syriæ tunc iuncta est. Iose. lib. 17. Antiq. ca. 19.

GLAPHYRA Alexãdri Cappadocum regis filia, nupsit primùm Alexandro fratri Archelai supradicti, deinde Iubæ Maurorum Regi, deinde ipsi etiam Archelao, qui contra legem Mariam priorem vxorem dimisit. præterea susceperat ex Glaphyra filios Alexander, huius Archelai frater: quare apparuit vxori in somnis exprobrans ei in hæc verba: Nunc confirmas prouerbium, fidem mulieribus non habendam: nonne mihi iureiurando constricta es, & iugali fœdere virgo sociata? post susceptos etiam filios (chara pignora) amoris nostri oblita es, iterum nubens, imò tertiò, atque cum meo fratre: nunquam tamen ego tui obliuiscar: quin liberabo te opprobriis,& efficiam vt mea, sicut fuisti, in perpetuum sis.ac post paucos dies hæc obiit.Iose. lib. 17. ca. 19.

page.notes: The two medallion legends are printed on the woodcuts; the left one begins with "R" and a mark that I cannot read clearly, so it is given as R.[?]IVD. The word "Iudæa" in the first paragraph, after "nam", is partly hidden by a smudge and is marked [?]. The first letter of "ARCHELAVS" and "GLAPHYRA" is set in capitals as printed, not as a heading. No marginal notes.
